newsitem.title: SPAIN: Albanian soccer players seek asylum in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Albanian soccer players seek asylum in Spain.

text.p: At least eight members of Albania's under-21 soccer squad abandoned their team in Spain on Thursday and planned to seek asylum, their coach said.

The players, who were scheduled to leave for Albania after playing two matches in southern Spain, did not get on a flight with the rest of the team out of Madrid airport and were taken away in a police bus, eyewitnesses said.
Coach Suleiman Mema said eight or nine of the under-21 players had left the team at Madrid airport.
"They will ask officially for asylum," he told Reuters.
The rest of the team boarded a flight to Athens and were to continue on from there to Albania, which has been racked by weeks of political unrest and near-anarchy.
Late on Wednesday, Mema said two other under-21 players had already abandoned the team in Spain and were heading for Germany with hopes of playing in Frankfurt.
The Albanian national and under-21 teams were playing matches in the southern Spanish city of Granada after the unrest in Albania forced the games to be moved from home venues.
